strings.ap_already: This appointment has already been handled
strings.ap_replaced: The time changed during the call; the earlier "{}" is still in your calendar. Please delete it.
strings.ap_sales_voided: Judged a sales call, so the appointment booked during the call was canceled: {}
strings.ap_sms_busy: the same text is already being sent
strings.ap_sms_cannot: can't text this number, so call them back yourself
strings.ap_sms_no: Sorry, {} won't work for me after all. Could we find another time?
strings.ap_sms_off: won't be sent ("Text the caller" is off in Settings)
strings.ap_sms_ok: {} works for me. See you then!
strings.ap_sms_old_app: the phone app is too old to send texts
strings.ap_sms_will: sent when you tap Accept or Decline
strings.ap_time_unconfirmed: The caller never confirmed this time read back; check it with them before you answer
strings.ap_void_failed: "{}" from the call was canceled but couldn't be removed from your calendar. Please delete it yourself.
strings.bl_announced_hint: blocked number: the announcement was played, then hung up (no AI)
strings.bl_declined_hint: blocked number: declined while it rang (no AI)
strings.bl_declined_reply: declined while it rang: not picked up (no AI)
strings.cw_end_hint: call waiting: the phone was on another call and turned it away (no AI)
strings.cw_matter: came in during another call; the phone turned it away as busy{sim}
strings.f_callback_no_number: No number to call back: the task has no contact and the caller's number is empty.
strings.f_callback_send_failed: Could not send the call back
strings.f_callback_waiting: The call back is scheduled, but the phone's control link is offline. Make sure the phone is connected to the agent, then confirm again.
strings.f_callback_whitelist: The call-back number is not on the allowed list. Add it (or a prefix ending in *) in Settings, then confirm again.
strings.f_email_no_address: This task sends an email but has no reply address. Add the contact from the transcript, or ignore the task.
strings.f_gmail_missing: Gmail is not set up. Enter the Gmail address and app password in Settings, then confirm again.
strings.f_openclaw_failed: Could not hand the task to OpenClaw: {} (check the OpenClaw URL and token in Settings)
strings.g_bad_address: The Gmail address does not look right. Check it in Settings.
strings.g_bad_recipient: Not sent: the recipient address does not look right
strings.g_short_password: The Gmail app password is too short. Enter it again in Settings (it is never shown).
strings.h_ai_ended: the AI answered and talked; the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)
strings.h_ai_fail_hangup: the AI could not connect; the system hung up and the caller heard nothing
strings.h_ai_fail_voicemail: the AI failed; the call went to voicemail
strings.h_reject_hidden: hidden number: the refusal announcement was played, then hung up (the AI did not answer)
strings.h_reject_list: blocked number: the unavailable announcement was played, then hung up (the AI did not answer)
strings.h_scam_stalling_off: the system judged it a sales / scam call ({t}); stalling is off, so the AI answered as usual
strings.h_stall_released: the system first took it for a sales / scam call; a second check found an ordinary call and the AI went back to talking normally
strings.h_stall_spam: the system judged it a sales / scam call ({t}), so the AI deliberately kept the caller talking to waste their time
strings.h_stall_spam_nokind: the system judged it a sales / scam call, so the AI deliberately kept the caller talking to waste their time
strings.h_urgent_failed: the caller said it was urgent: the phone called the owner but did not get through, and the AI told the caller the owner would call back soon; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to stall, so the to-do is to call them back as soon as possible
strings.h_urgent_merged: the caller said it was urgent: the phone called the owner, who picked up and was put through to the caller, and the AI left; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to stall
strings.h_urgent_transfer: the caller said it was urgent and the owner was alerted at once; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to stall, so the to-do is to call them back as soon as possible
strings.n_blocked_declined: Declined while it rang: not picked up, no AI
strings.n_blocked_done: Played "{}" and hung up. The AI was not used.
strings.n_fit_adjusted: Bageo adjusted the call audio by itself. It works now.
strings.n_fit_problem: Call audio has a problem and all settings were tried. See “First use on a new phone” in the guide.
strings.n_fit_test_body: This phone has not been tested yet. Call it from another phone and talk to the AI for about 20 seconds. Bageo then adjusts the call audio by itself.
strings.n_fit_test_title: New phone: test the call audio
strings.n_fit_unsupported: This phone cannot send the AI's voice into calls.
strings.n_repeat_body: More calls from {number} in the last minute: {count}. They were not sent one by one.
strings.n_test_body: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you can read it, the channel works.
strings.s_ai_fail_matter: The AI did not connect; the system hung up after about {} and the caller heard nothing
strings.s_ai_fail_prefix: [The AI did not connect; the system hung up]
strings.s_ai_failed: The AI did not connect and said nothing
strings.s_call_back_if_known: Call back if you know the number
strings.s_listen_recording: Listen to the recording in the web console
strings.s_no_service: No summary service is set up
strings.s_no_summary: (No summary — see the transcript in the web console.)
strings.s_no_transcript: The call lasted about {}; there is no usable transcript
strings.s_see_transcript: See the transcript in the web console
strings.s_stall_reply: Kept them talking for about {}; gave no data and agreed to nothing
strings.vm_call_back_unchecked: Wants a call back (number not checked)
strings.vm_call_back_unknown: Wants a call back on this number (confirmed with 1, but the number is unknown)
strings.vm_email_to: Wants a reply by email: {} (confirmed with 1)
strings.vm_email_unknown: Wants a reply by email (confirmed with 1, but the address is unknown)
strings.vm_no_choice: No reply method chosen (the call ended early)
strings.vm_no_transcript: A message of about {}; it could not be transcribed. Listen to the recording
strings.vm_task_failed: Voicemail (could not be transcribed; needs a look)
